name: player_ai_alert_attack_buddies
description: AINet::AiAlertAttackBuddies walks the AI peer ring, starts non-steering buddies in steering pursuit, and latches recent-hit alert state for 10 seconds.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player AI source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x401c00 shows the finalized-state gate, traversal through saveState->aiPeerRingNext until the ring returns to the source save state, AiEnterMode2SteeringPursuit dispatch only for buddies not already in steering top-level state, and recentHitFlag/recentHitExpireTime = g_Time_AccumulatedTimeSec + 10.0f writes for alerted buddies.
The native smoke checks finalized gate behavior, one alerted non-steering buddy, and one already-steering buddy that remains unmodified.
